rules.name: xoga713-accounting-report-recovery-scan
rules.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS object_name, c.relkind AS kind, c.reltuples::bigint AS approx_rows FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE c.relname ILIKE '%helper_var_accounting%' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT w.name AS needed_object, (SELECT c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname = w.name LIMIT 1) AS kind_found FROM (VALUES ('helper_var_future_view'), ('helper_var_vanilla_view'), ('var_bu_rule'), ('underlying_list_table'), ('vol_id_table'), ('future_cont_series_table'), ('option_cont_series_table')) AS w(name) ORDER BY 1
SELECT id, author, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id LIKE '%helper_var_accounting_report%' ORDER BY orderexecuted

expect.reason: a copy of the accounting data exists somewhere (a backup schema or the old table)
one row per needed object, kind_found is empty where it is missing
